title: Concept: Poetry source configured over cleartext
description: pyproject.toml declares a Poetry source URL that uses cleartext http, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Packages and their hashes cross the network unencrypted, so a network attacker can substitute both the file and the hash that verifies it.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pyproject.toml (pypi).
risk: Packages and their hashes cross the network unencrypted, so a network attacker can substitute both the file and the hash that verifies it.
